no_court_proceedings.additional_description: That is good news, let’s try to keep it that way. In any event, you cannot go to court until you have explored less stressful and expensive alternatives. We will help you identify these options. Whilst the family court performs a valuable function it should be reserved for high conflict, complex cases.

court_proceedings_in_court.additional_description: We are sorry you are in court proceedings. The family court is sometimes an appropriate way to resolve matters. 1.title: Affordability
1.description:
What is your approximate annual income before tax? Include earnings and state benefits.
You may wonder why we ask this question, {name}. Some dispute resolution models are more affordable than others, and some, dependent on income, may be covered by Legal Aid. We want to tailor our guidance to your circumstances. Equally, we want to be sure we are helping people from every walk of society.
1.question: What is your approximate annual income before tax? Include earnings and state benefits.

1.title: Your Financial Picture
1.description:
To help us better understand the overall financial situation and provide appropriate guidance, please indicate the approximate net assetsThis includes the family home, savings, investments, property, and trusts minus the mortgage and other any debts collectively held by you and {partner_name}. You do not need to calculate an exact figure-an estimate is sufficient.

Some dispute resolution pathways are more affordable than others and we want to make sure our recommendation will be a good fit for your financial circumstances
